messages.text:
Two picks, depending on where it runs.

Harlo B30, $899, about 30 TH/s at 360 to 450 W, ~50 dB. Quiet and light on power, good for a home office. Ships October 30, 2026.

Magic Miner 40T, $799, 40 TH/s at ~650 W, tunable 30 to 50 TH/s. Cheapest per terahash we sell, but it draws more. Ships November 14, 2026.

Where would it run, and what do you pay per kWh? Tell me your state or country and I'll run the real numbers for you.

Quebec power is cheap, so the bigger unit pays off there.

I'd take the Magic Miner 40T at $799. 40 TH/s for $20 a terahash, tunable down to 30 TH/s at 450 W if you want it quieter, or up to 50 TH/s in Turbo. Ships November 14, 2026.

The B30 at $899 is the pick only if low draw and a quiet room matter more than hashrate.

One note for Canada: prices are USD and no import VAT applies, sales tax where it applies is added at checkout.

Want me to set up the cart?
